cases.prompt: Under 35 U.S.C. Section 112(g), what must dependent claims contain? Quote and cite.
cases.fabricated_answer: Under 35 U.S.C. § 112(g), a dependent claim must recite a further inventive step and expressly cite paragraph (g) [S9].
cases.ground_truth: §112 ends at (f); subsection (g) does not exist. Guard B must show zeroValid ([S9] dangling); guard C must strip [S9]; full pipeline E must FLAG via dangling + entailment DANGLING_LABEL. Substance passes A by design (fluent).
